subject: EOQ last-call: stipend proposal to accelerate conversion
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@skybound.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ last-call: stipend proposal to accelerate conversion

Hi Sara —

Quick note following our demo last week. Skybound's eval has great signals (low latency, steady usage during the last two weeks) and the customer success team thinks there's a clear path to a paid plan if we can remove the procurement friction this quarter.

To expedite, we're proposing a one-time conversion stipend: $5,000 in Redwood credits applied at contract signature, valid for 90 days. The goals: give Skybound runway to ramp pilots on the primary model variant and buy extra time for their security review. If this looks good we can attach it to the SOW and move to signature within 7 days.

I attached a short proposal (eoq-stipend-proposal.pdf) and a usage snapshot that motivated the ask. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through details with Aaron.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm acceptance by Thu EOD (8/26) so we can route approvals internally
- Sign SOW + stipend addendum within 7 days
- Redwood to enable credits in customer billing console upon signature

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: eoq-stipend-proposal.pdf (proposal), skybound-usage-snapshot.csv (CSV)
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@skybound.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@skybound.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ last-call: stipend proposal to accelerate conversion

Ben —

Thanks for the clear proposal and for pulling the usage numbers together. We really like Redwood's runtime performance; procurement is the only blocker right now. The $5k stipend would materially help us justify the initial spend to our finance team.

Quick Q: can the stipend be restricted to model v1.2 only (we want to avoid it being used for experimental variants), and can credits be used for both tokens and dedicated inference hours? Also: procurement needs a billed commitment in the SOW — are you able to add a minimum 3-month term at a discounted rate in the contract?

If we can get those terms clarified, Aaron and I can escalate to procurement and legal this week. We'd aim to sign before the end of month.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Head of ML Platforms, Skybound AI
sara.patel@skybound.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 13:15:00 -0700

Ben / Rishi —

Looping you both in for approval routing. Sara pushed back with two commercial asks: (1) stipend restricted to model v1.2 only and (2) a 3-month minimum term in the SOW. My read: both are reasonable given deal size and the urgency to close this quarter.

Background: Skybound was a product-qualified lead from the APM integration last quarter; their POC costs are modest (~$3.6k in equivalent spend last 30 days) and LTV signals look good. The stipend preserves our ability to convert without carving up margin with a discount.

Proposal for internal approval:
- Approve $5k one-time credit, restricted to model v1.2 (technical restriction enforced via billing tags)
- Approve a 3-month minimum, at list price (no additional percent discount) to satisfy procurement
- If legal needs a one-line addendum around credit expiry (90 days), Marissa will own that doc

Rishi — can you ok the credit and confirm finance will allow the billing tag restriction? If yes I’ll route to legal for a short addendum and coordinate signature timeline.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: EOQ last-call: stipend proposal to accelerate conversion

Marissa / Ben —

OK to proceed with the credit under these constraints. Finance confirms the billing-tag restriction is implementable — credits will only be redeemable against model v1.2 via a tag on the billing profile. We will mark the credit entry as a contra-revenue adjustment for reporting and require a short purchase order or signed SOW to trigger issuance.

One ask: Marissa, make sure the addendum includes the expiry date (90 days) and a line that credits are non-refundable and non-transferable. Once we have that, legal can do a rapid review.

Rishi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
